title: ctenophyllum adanum
intro: Ctenophyllum adanum, commonly known as Mountain Mint, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Lamiaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, and is often used to soothe digestive issues and relieve pain. The therapeutic actions of Ctenophyllum adanum are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, ease respiratory issues, and calm the nervous system, making it a popular natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
